env_context_strategy.note: Prompt injects memory/checklist context while the underlying provider CLI (Claude Code etc.) navigates the repo with its own tools; MCP ChromaDB code search also shipped.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Output-token compressor for free-form generation only (never trust-gate subcalls).

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: runs autonomous RARV cycles (Reason - Act - Reflect - Verify, see `run.sh:run_autonomous()`) with 8 quality gates
loop_primitives.note: Default is the RARV-C loop: react plus harness-run tests/gates and re-iteration (generate_test_repair); `loki plan` pre-execution analysis and phase pipeline give plan_execute; retries/iterations until council stops.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: An OpenAPI/GraphQL/Postman contract expands into a per-operation build checklist (one item per operationId/field/request)

multi_agent_topology.note: 41 roles are prompt personas adopted by one orchestrator; parallel blind review council and optional worktree streams on Claude Code reachable.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: prompt-defined specifications the orchestrator adopts per phase, with parallel review (blind council) and optional worktree streams on Claude Code
delegation_mechanism.note: Roles are adopted per phase rather than spawned as separate agents; Claude Code subagents/Task tool reachable on Tier 1.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: loki steer "<note>" | Nudge a running build with a directive (writes `.loki/HUMAN_INPUT.md`; the loop reads it when `LOKI_PROMPT_INJECTION=1`)
human_in_loop.note: Human review expected for deploy/PR publish (`loki ship --publish`); steering is env-gated hence configurable; runs are otherwise unattended.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The second command consumes `.loki/state/pr-title.txt` and `.loki/state/pr-body.md` byte-for-byte.
short_term_state.note: `.loki/state`, checklist status, gate verdicts and outcome ledger form a typed run state beyond messages.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: **Cross-project memory** -- Episodic/semantic/procedural memory with vector search; knowledge learned on one project surfaces on the next
long_term_memory.note: Also LOKI_AUTO_LEARNINGS / LOKI_HANDOFF_MD write markdown notes; procedural memory ~ skill library.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: bind-mounting the current folder so `.loki` state and resume work exactly like local

self_verification.evidence_quote: 8 quality gates (`skills/quality-gates.md`), blind 3-reviewer code review (`run.sh:run_code_review()`), anti-sycophancy checks
self_verification.note: Gates include static analysis, test suite pass/fail, blind council (llm_judge), Devil's Advocate (self_critique), secret scan and dependency audit.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: The full RARV-C closure loop (Reason - Act - Reflect - Verify - Close) runs until the work is actually done, not just attempted.
retry_policy.note: Loop exits on council stop, max iterations, or a positively-identified permanent failure (LOKI_SMART_RETRY).

rollback.note: Git 2.x required "for checkpoints and worktrees"; `loki rollback` routed to the Bun runtime.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: It stops when the completion council votes stop (`council_should_stop` in `autonomy/completion-council.sh`), a completion promise is met, max iterations is hit, or (v8.0.0) a failure is positively identified as non-retryable
termination_condition.note: Cost cap via Claude Code `--max-budget-usd`; stagnation/stuck-detector valves give stall_detection; verified completion (tests green) ends the run.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Opus for planning/architecture, Sonnet for development, Haiku for unit tests and simple parallel work
cost_controls.note: Tier routing = model_routing; `--max-budget-usd` and LOKI_MAX_TIER give token/cost budget; LOKI_CAVEMAN compresses output tokens. Caching inferred from provider CLI, weaker evidence.

timeouts.note: `autonomy/lib/deadline.py` suggests run-level deadlines; exact timeout values not in evidence.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Every other command continues to execute on the existing Bash CLI (`autonomy/loki`), including the autonomous `loki start` / `loki run` loop which remains the Bash orchestrator (`autonomy/run.sh`).
execution_isolation.note: Default runs on the host driving a local provider CLI; container path reachable via `loki docker start` and Dockerfile.sandbox / autonomy/sandbox.sh.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: bind-mounting the current folder so `.loki` state and resume work exactly like local
